name: ExecuteTerraformPlan

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Format: [0-9a-zA-Z-]{1,64}. We recommend that you use a UUID
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The Terraform code to execute. If the execution content has not changed, you can specify only stateId
parameters.help_zh: 需要执行的Terraform代码内容，如果执行内容无变化，可以只传入stateId
parameters.name: code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the state file. If this parameter is specified, the Plan command continues to run based on the existing state file
parameters.help_zh: 状态文件ID，该字段不为空时，在原有状态文件基础上面继续执行Plan命令
parameters.name: state_id

stateId.description_en: The ID of the state file
